tasks.subject: Create the Phase 8 WBS, tasks JSON, handoff, and specialist brief
tasks.description: Create the Phase 8 planning package for Environment Audio Polish.

tasks.subject: Audit current audio contract and lock the execution slice
tasks.description: Reviewed generated cue behavior, weather loop handling, and current QA visibility, then locked the Phase 8 execution slice without widening scope. Findings are captured in docs/development/phase8-audio-audit.md.

tasks.subject: Expand generated cue tuning contract and cue profile definitions
tasks.description: Added config-friendly cue tuning for generated audio through gameBalance.audio.maxSimultaneous and gameBalance.audio.cueProfiles, then wired those profiles into GeneratedAudioCuePlayer and AudioFeedbackController with pure unit coverage.

tasks.subject: Improve runtime prioritization, loop switching, and anti-fatigue behavior
tasks.description: Centralized active weather-loop ownership in AudioFeedbackController, added config-driven cue-rule overrides, and introduced runtime cooldown protection for loop replay while preserving deterministic routing.

tasks.subject: Expose audio debug and HUD-facing state for QA
tasks.description: Exposed audio runtime state through HUD and debug payloads so manual playtests and browser tests can verify mix and loop decisions.

tasks.subject: Add deterministic unit coverage for audio routing and loop behavior
tasks.description: Expanded unit coverage for cue selection, override rules, loop dedup, reset handling, and generated-tone override behavior.

tasks.subject: Expand browser coverage for weather and combat audio behavior
tasks.description: Extend E2E coverage so weather loop switching, repeated cue suppression, and combat audio visibility remain deterministic in the browser.

tasks.subject: Update Phase 8 playtest, tuning, and direction documents
tasks.description: Refresh docs so Environment Audio Polish has explicit tuning and QA guidance.

tasks.subject: Run verification gates, refresh execution report, and sync postflight
tasks.description: Close Phase 8 with verification, execution report refresh, and postflight sync.
